load: How a page links the files of the kit, in this order (it is the cascade). block: a stylesheet the first paint waits for. late: a stylesheet that only paints boxes the blocking ones already laid out (it sets custom properties only, test/load.test.mjs), so the first paint does not wait for it and nothing moves when it comes: <link rel="stylesheet" media="print" onload="this.media='all'"> and the plain link in <noscript>. defer: <script defer>. A file with a part is linked only when the page asks for that part. Each file also ships as .min.
